messages:
pagerbot: [PAGER] west-1 GPU cluster queue > 90% for 7m, throttling increased, autoscaler failing to provision new nodes :rotating_light:
infra-bot: created incident INC-3102467890, paging oncall_kai
oncall_kai: oncall here, joining channel
oncall_kai: quick snapshot — queue backlog concentrated on model 'conversational-v2' in pool west-1-gpu
leo (eng-sre): seeing spike in request retries and a surge of small-duration batches. Interesting: continuous_batch_ms jumped from 15 -> 180 around 3102467600
marta (eng-runtime): that corresponds to rollout of batching-experiments v3 (deployed 3102467550). The rollout included an experiments override for high-throughput routes
nina (eng-ml): also high prefix cache miss rate on conversation prefixes, miss ~78% vs normal ~4%. KV miss spikes correlate with rollback attempts
renee (cs): support volume up, customers reporting slow responses and dashboard timeouts (ticket tags: paycart, marketflow)
product_lead: do we have data loss? any 5xxs?
leo (eng-sre): no sustained 5xx spike, mostly increased latency and client-side retries. Autoscaler logs show `scale_decision_denied: pool_max_reached` at 3102467665 — pool max_nodes is at configured 10
noncall_kai: can infra lift the cap temporarily? need to stop throttles.
marta (eng-runtime): requesting manual pool override: `infra-ops request override --pool west-1-gpu --max-nodes 20 --reason "emergency scale"`
infra-bot: override request IR-79214 submitted, awaiting approver group
leo (eng-sre): mitigation plan: 1) revert batching-experiments to previous config 2) run prefix cache warm for hot prefixes 3) drain non-critical traffic off pool 4) monitor queue until <50%
renee (cs): customers to notify: paycart (high impact), marketflow (medium). Drafting notice: intermittent timeouts and latency, mitigation in progress
marta (eng-runtime): starting rollback now:
```bash
# rollback experiments rollout
rollouts rollback deployment/batching-experiments --to-revision=18 --namespace=runtime
```
marta (eng-runtime): rollback kicked at 3102467722
leo (eng-sre): kicking a cache warm job for top prefixes (list generated from recent hot keys):
```bash
jobs submit cache-warm --pool west-1-gpu --model conversational-v2 --prefixes /var/tmp/top_prefixes_310246.txt
```
infra-bot: cache-warm job queued job-3102467735
infra-bot: override IR-79214 approved, pool max_nodes set to 20 at 3102467750
leo (eng-sre): autoscaler accepted scale requests, new node provisioning started 3102467762, 3 nodes booting
nina (eng-ml): prefix cache miss dropping to ~35% after warm job starts, KV hitrate improving
renee (cs): paycart reports timeouts decreasing; marketflow still seeing elevated 95th latency but better than 10m ago
product_lead: what caused experiments to push this config? Was there a safety gate?
marta (eng-runtime): experiments pipeline mistakenly set `continuous_batch_ms: 180` as a default for routes tagged 'high-throughput' due to a bad fixture. No gating on max batch window was enforced. Will add a hard guard.
leo (eng-sre): short-term: queue depth reduced 92% -> 40% over ~8m, tail latency improving. Marking incident as mitigated when stable
noncall_kai: I'll stay on until metrics are green for 30m, then hand off
infra-bot: incident INC-3102467890 status updated -> mitigated at 3102468070
renee (cs): customer comms sent: impacted window 3102467550-3102468070, root cause: batching rollout + cold prefix cache + pool cap, remediation steps applied, no data loss reported
marta (eng-runtime): post-incident action items: 1) add gating rule `continuous_batch_ms <= 50` for routes in runtime experiments 2) add cache-warm step to rollback/rollout playbook 3) add alert when prefix cache miss > 20% for 3m on hot models
nina (eng-ml): I'll run regression checks to ensure quality unaffected by smaller batch windows and update Optimize suggestions for customers
leo (eng-sre): follow-ups: automate emergency scale override runbook, instrument request-retry vs backpressure signals, put a guard on experiments defaults
noncall_kai: final check — any remaining impacted customers? renree? (typo)
renee (cs): small account 'devtestlabs' still seeing spikes but low volume, CS will remediate per-account and recommend dedicated pool for SLA needs
noncall_kai: thanks team, preparing timeline for postmortem. leaving oncall at 3102468210
pagerbot: Incident INC-3102467890 marked resolved (mitigated)
